get_max_id_column_cnt: get the maximum ID column count for a given PID protocol type
get_pid_protocol_from_num_shards: determine the PID protocol based on the number of shards and multikey flag
pid_should_use_row_numbers: check if row numbers should be used for a given PID protocol configuration
get_sharded_filepath: generate a sharded file path by appending the shard index to the base path
get_pid_metrics: read PID metrics from storage and return them as a dictionary of key-value pairs
